title: Profile
lead: What employers see, how to reach you and what you expect from work

fields.experienceHint: Full years, 0 means under a year
fields.aboutHint: Employers see this text after you accept an invitation or apply yourself
fields.contactsNote: Contacts open to a company only after you accept its invitation or apply
fields.stackLead: Self-reported: the lightest signal, it never changes your category. Only the test does.
fields.salaryNote: Employers do not see it: it is used to estimate how likely you are to accept an invitation.

resume.lead: Upload a PDF and the fields fill in by themselves. Your profile changes only when you save.
resume.drop: Drop a PDF here or choose a file
resume.limit: PDF up to 5 MB and 10 pages, with a text layer
resume.manual: You can fill the fields in by hand.
resume.privacy: The file is not stored and never leaves for external services: parsing runs on our server.
resume.gradeHint: Your experience and roles suggest {{grade}}. This is only a hint for choosing a grade; the test sets the category.

visibility.lead: What employers see on your anonymised card before you accept an invitation. It does not affect matching.
visibility.always: Always visible: category, skill profile, work format
visibility.never: Always hidden until disclosure: name, contacts, about, roles, soft skills

fsp.lead: FSP achievements carry the most weight in your profile. There is no penalty without them: the profile is built from the test.
fsp.notLinked: FSP ID is not linked. If you took part in FSP competitions, link it and your results will be pulled from the registry.
fsp.noSnapshot: The registry has not answered yet
fsp.unlinkText: Achievements and their contribution to your skill profile will be removed. You can link it again at any time.
fsp.noAchievements: The registry has no results for you yet.
fsp.divergenceText: In these topics your FSP result is above your test level. This is not a penalty: a short verification block can confirm the level.
fsp.returnLinkedText: Achievements came from the registry and are already counted in your skill profile.

preview.title: How employers see you
preview.lead: Anonymised card before you accept an invitation or apply
preview.later: After you accept an invitation the company sees your full name, contacts, about text, roles, soft skills and experience.
preview.yearsNote: Counted from experience entries: overlaps are not doubled, gaps are left out. Self-reported, not used in matching.

errors.experience_years: Enter your experience, 0 means under a year
errors.work_formats: Choose at least one work format
errors.city: Enter your city: it is required for office and hybrid
errors.salary_from: Enter the salary you would consider offers from

experience.lead: Jobs and projects. Employers see them after disclosure, marked as self-reported. Experience does not affect matching or your category.
experience.drawerLead: Place, period, technologies and what you did
experience.stackHint: Years by technology are counted from these
experience.summaryHint: Tasks and results in your own words
experience.emptyText: Add jobs and projects or upload a resume and the entries will be filled from it.
experience.note: Entry changes are saved together with the profile.

errors.future: The start cannot be in the future
errors.beforeStart: The end is before the start
